scope.package_review: reviews/batch-02.md read in full. Its factual cautions are not treated as evidence by themselves. Original SHA values rechecked after reading.

scope.field_convention: Numbered sections and paragraphs are one-based, matching Parsed essay-body.lang-zh and received Markdown. Before/after below are exact targeted textual spans unless explicitly marked whole paragraph. Adjacent argument and examples remain.

overall: Both English essays retain the complete source argument, examples, caveats and repetitions. Neither is a summary. Natural English is generally good. Publication blockers are inherited source statistics, arithmetic and scope claims, not substantial new English omissions. Corrections below preserve the central distinction between an event, its measurement and a conventional scoring system; they should not be used to deny measurable accuracy improvements or convert a documentary gap into proof of institutional absence.

sources.title: Mann, Ivey, Brechue and Mayhew (2015), Validity and Reliability of Hand and Electronic Timing for 40-yd Sprint in College Football Players, DOI 10.1519/JSC.0000000000000941
sources.actually_read: Abstract, Table 1 including its mean-and-SD footnote, methods describing participants/start/finish, and Table 2. Later attempted PDF output was truncated and is not claimed as read.
sources.supports: 81 NCAA Division I football players; reported differences 0.22±0.07 and 0.26±0.08 are means and standard deviations. Electronic start was a ground hand touchpad, finish infrared; not gun-started 100 m FAT.

sources.actually_read: Full page including applicability and unofficial-calculator disclaimer.
sources.supports: This combined-events calculator specifies +0.24 below 400m and +0.14 at 400m for hand times. It does not authorize adding 0.24 to every official result or record.

sources.actually_read: Official 2026 rules targeted indexed provisions 19.13.1–2 and zero-test provision; direct PDF fetch returned 403. Not a complete current-rule audit.
sources.supports: Separate photo-finish sampling requirement and constant trigger-delay requirement ≤0.001 s. Delay is not a resolution or total-accuracy bound.

sources.actually_read: Full disciplinary description and rules portion.
sources.supports: Two-day ten-discipline points competition, three attempts in named field events and aggregate score for placing; no ordinary progression into a decathlon final. Page illustrates historical scores in current-table equivalents.

sources.actually_read: Full article, especially Individual Gundersen, Compact and Mass Start sections.
sources.supports: Four seconds per point is the described Individual Gundersen conversion. Compact uses fixed place-based gaps, while Mass Start ends with jumping; cannot generalize to all Nordic combined formats.

findings.reason: Paragraph 4 has already assigned 0.24 to a specific straight-100m arrangement. Its numerical position between 0.18 and 0.26 does not establish that the federation selected an arithmetic compromise or that it fits no race. No new evidence is needed to resolve this internal contradiction.
findings.before_zh: 挑中的偏偏是中间那个值，这件事也值得看一眼。零点一八对应靠近发令枪的位置，零点二六对应弯道，零点二四在中间。选中间那个当通用常数，像是一种折中，可是折中在这里没有道理，因为一场具体的比赛不是折中的，它要么是直道要么是弯道，计时员要么靠近枪要么不靠近。用一个中间值去套一场非直即弯的比赛，对哪一种都不完全对。这个常数从被选出来的方式上，就已经不属于任何一场具体的比赛。
findings.after_zh: 挑中的偏偏是中间那个值，这件事也值得看一眼。零点一八对应靠近发令枪的位置，零点二六对应弯道，零点二四在中间，但它也对应前面说的那种一百米直道条件。不能仅仅因为它在三个数中间，就断定它是折中选出来的。真正的问题是迁移：一场具体的比赛有自己的发令位置、计时员位置和反应差异。把一种条件下的平均差固定下来，拿去连接不同条件下的成绩，能方便比较，却不能保证每一次都恰好补对。
findings.before_en: The very manner of its selection means that this constant already belongs to no particular race.
findings.after_en: The selected value happens to lie between the other two: 0.18 near the pistol, 0.26 on the bend, and 0.24 in between. But 0.24 also corresponds to the particular straight-hundred-metre arrangement described above. Its position in the middle does not establish that it was chosen as a compromise. The real question is transfer. Each race has its own starting arrangements, timer positions and human responses. Fixing an average from one set of conditions makes different results easier to connect; it does not guarantee the right correction for every individual observation.
findings.english_scope: Replace the whole corresponding paragraph, not only the quoted final sentence.

findings.type: source statistical interpretation and external-validity error
findings.reason: Mann et al. report SD, not hard bounds. Twice 0.07 is not a universal uncertainty limit or a minimum meaningful 100m difference. The movement/touchpad-start 40-yard setup differs from gun-started FAT. The study cannot by itself validate the 1972 constant or every historical observation.

patches.before_zh: 有一项针对八十一名大学男生跑四十码冲刺的研究，经验丰富的计时员的手计时与电计时的平均差是零点二二秒，上下浮动零点零七秒;经验不足的计时员是零点二六秒，上下浮动零点零八秒。
patches.after_zh: 有一项针对八十一名美国大学橄榄球运动员跑四十码冲刺的研究，经验丰富的计时员所记手计时与电计时的平均差为零点二二秒，差值的标准差为零点零七秒；经验不足的计时员，两个数分别为零点二六秒和零点零八秒。这项研究用手离开地面触板来启动电子计时，用红外装置记录终点，和发令枪启动的一百米全自动计时不是同一种布置。
patches.before_en: In one study of eighty-one male university students running forty-yard sprints, experienced timers recorded an average difference of 0.22 seconds between hand and electronic timing, with a spread of ±0.07 seconds. For inexperienced timers, the figures were 0.26 and ±0.08 seconds.
patches.after_en: In a study of eighty-one US college football players running forty-yard sprints, the mean difference between hand and electronic times was 0.22 seconds for experienced timers, with a standard deviation of 0.07 seconds. For inexperienced timers, those figures were 0.26 and 0.08 seconds. Electronic timing began when the athlete's hand left a ground touchpad and ended at an infrared beam. This was not the same arrangement as gun-started fully automatic timing for the hundred metres.

patches.before_zh: 再看那两个浮动，零点零七和零点零八。这两个数才是重点。
patches.after_zh: 再看那两个标准差，零点零七和零点零八。这两个数提醒我们，平均差之外还有离散。
patches.before_en: Now look at the two measures of spread, 0.07 and 0.08. Those are the important numbers.
patches.after_en: Now look at the two standard deviations, 0.07 and 0.08. They remind us that an average difference does not eliminate variation.

patches.before_zh: 浮动零点零七的意思是，即便平均值是零点二二，具体到某一次计时，差值可能是零点一五，也可能是零点二九。这个范围的宽度接近零点一五秒。而在一百米这个项目里，零点一五秒是一个巨大的量，它足以区分一块金牌和一块没有名次的成绩。
patches.after_zh: 标准差零点零七不是说所有差值都被关在零点一五到零点二九之间。这两个数只是平均值上下各一个标准差的位置，实际差值还可能落在外面。它说明的是，在这项研究的条件下，给每次手计时加上同一个平均数，并不会把每次误差都消掉。至于一百米，奖牌常常就在很小的时间差里分出，比较时更不能把换算后的两位小数当成已经逐次核实的精度。
patches.before_en: The width of that range approaches 0.15 seconds.
patches.after_en: A standard deviation of 0.07 does not confine all differences to the interval from 0.15 to 0.29. Those are merely the positions one standard deviation below and above the mean; observations can fall outside them. Under this study's conditions, adding the same average to every hand time would not remove each individual error. In the hundred metres, where medals can turn on tiny margins, two decimal places after a conversion should not be mistaken for precision independently verified in every case.

patches.before_zh: 也就是说，如果两个手计时的成绩靠这个常数换算之后放在一起比，它们之间小于零点一五秒的差距，是没有意义的，因为换算本身的抖动就有这么大。
patches.after_zh: 这并不推出一个适用于所有一百米成绩的零点一五秒门槛。两个换算成绩之间的小差距能说明多少，还要看原始计时的条件、误差及两者是否可比；不能只凭这个平均常数就宣布名次已经精确到百分之一秒。
patches.before_en: In other words, when two hand-timed performances are converted using this constant and then compared, a difference smaller than 0.15 seconds is meaningless, because the conversion itself fluctuates by that much.
patches.after_en: This does not establish a universal 0.15-second threshold for hundred-metre performances. How much a small gap between two converted times tells us depends on the original timing conditions, errors and comparability. The average correction alone cannot certify a ranking to the hundredth.
patches.additional_edit: Also remove the earlier sentence in the same paragraph asserting that this study establishes individual conversion uncertainty approaching 0.15. Keep the medal-margin illustration and cloth metaphor, but replace the final fixed-precision claim by '能把两块布缝在一起，却不能仅凭一道缝保证细到百分之一秒的名次。' / 'The constant can stitch two pieces of cloth together; the seam alone cannot guarantee a ranking to the hundredth.'

patches.before_zh: 所以这项研究说明的事情是这样:这个常数的平均值是可靠的，而它对个体是不可靠的。用它来描述一大批计时的整体倾向，它是准的;用它来修正某一次具体的计时，它可能差得很远，而且没有办法知道这一次差了多少。
patches.after_zh: 所以这项研究至少说明：一种条件下测得的平均差，可以描述那组计时的整体倾向，却不能直接充当每一次计时的准确修正。若没有那次比赛更完整的独立记录，就不能仅凭平均数知道它究竟差了多少。这也不能反过来证明，另一年代、另一种计时布置里的常数已经得到全面验证。
patches.before_en: The study thus tells us this: the average underlying the constant is reliable, but its application to individuals is not.
patches.after_en: The study establishes at least this much: a mean difference measured under particular conditions can describe that set of observations without supplying the exact correction for each one. Without a fuller independent record of a particular race, the mean alone cannot tell us its error. Nor does this validate a constant from another period and another timing arrangement.

findings.type: source arithmetic-direction error and unsupported rationale
findings.reason: Earlier start plus later stop lengthens elapsed time; it cannot explain a faster reading. Do not simply replace it by a new universal opposite assertion. Rounding direction is a reporting convention, not by itself proof of a particular legislative motive. Additional +0.24 applies only where the governing conversion procedure calls for it.
findings.before_zh: 因为手计时本来就有一个系统性的偏差，人按表总是偏早启动，偏晚停止，所以手计时倾向于偏快。
findings.after_zh: 手计时会受到发令反应和终点判断的影响，某些研究和换算惯例所面对的是平均偏快的手计时。但不能把它解释成“偏早启动、偏晚停止”：那样反而会把用时记长。向上进位规定的是读数如何报出，只朝较慢的一侧取值；单凭这条规则，还不能断定它就是为某一种反应偏差设计的补偿。
findings.zh_scope: Replace whole paragraph 6, including the original following compensation explanation.
findings.before_en: Because hand timing already has a systematic bias: people start their watches too early and stop them too late, so hand times tend to be faster.
findings.after_en: Hand timing is affected by responses to the start and judgments at the finish. Some studies and conversion conventions address hand times that are faster on average. But starting early and stopping late would lengthen a recorded time, not shorten it. Upward rounding specifies how a reading is reported, always toward the slower value. The rule alone does not establish that it was designed to compensate for one particular response bias.
findings.english_scope: Replace whole paragraph 6, retaining the opening question if desired.

paragraph7_change.before_zh: 于是手计时的成绩里，叠了两层调整。
paragraph7_change.after_zh: 在采用这类零点二四秒换算的场合，手计时的成绩里便叠了两层处理。
paragraph7_change.before_en: Two layers of adjustment are therefore superimposed on a hand time.
paragraph7_change.after_en: Where this 0.24-second conversion is used, two procedures are superimposed on a hand time.

findings.type: source confuses trigger delay and resolution
findings.before_zh: 可查的国际田联规则要求全自动计时系统由发令枪自动启动，延迟恒定且小于一毫秒。也就是说，系统内部对时间的把握精细到毫秒级。
findings.after_zh: 可查的世界田联规则分别规定了全自动终点摄影的采样要求，以及发令信号与计时启动之间恒定且不超过一毫秒的延迟。这里的启动延迟不是系统分辨率，也不是整套测量的总误差；它们是不同的技术指标。
findings.before_en: The accessible IAAF rules require fully automatic timing to be started automatically by the starting pistol, with a constant delay of less than one millisecond. Internally, then, the system handles time at millisecond resolution.
findings.after_en: The accessible World Athletics rules separately specify photo-finish sampling requirements and a constant delay of no more than one millisecond between the starting signal and activation of the timing system. That trigger delay is neither the system's resolution nor a bound on its total measurement error; these are different technical quantities.
findings.reason: The official limit is ≤, not <. Keep the paragraph's final published-unit contrast, without inferring resolution from latency. No need to add numerical sampling rates unless the exact competition-category condition is also retained.

findings.type: source documentary scope / asserted institutional motive
findings.before_zh: 而这个构从第二篇里那句授权条文开始，拿到的一直是登记的权力，不是注销的权力。
findings.after_zh: 第二篇引的那句早期授权条文写的是登记；但不能仅凭那一句，就断定后来从未形成注销权限。
findings.before_en: Yet ever since the authorising provision quoted in Essay Two, the power granted to this construct has been the power to register, not to cancel.
findings.after_en: The early authorising provision quoted in Essay Two speaks of registration. That sentence alone cannot establish that no power of cancellation developed later.
findings.reason: Apply the same missing-document boundary already accepted for EP02. Revise the paragraph's subsequent '所以/总是' into interpretation of these examples, and last sentence as below, not a proven absent power.

ending.before_zh: 它绕开了它没有的那个权力。
ending.after_zh: 在这些例子里，改变账面可以通过调整登记资格完成，不必把每一次变化都写成宣布过去记错了；这不等于我们已经证明它没有别的权限。
ending.before_en: The construct avoids exercising the power it does not possess.
ending.after_en: In these examples, changing eligibility can alter the ledger without describing each change as a declaration that the past was recorded wrongly. This does not establish that the institution lacked other powers.

findings.type: source denies comparative accuracy without evidence
findings.reason: An inaccessible perfectly exact duration does not imply that two methods have equal accuracy, or that FAT recognition was unrelated to improved measurement. Preserve standardization/measurement-versus-event argument, but do not categorically deny that 9.95 can be a better measurement. This is not a request to remove the author's imprint metaphor.

patches.before_zh: 它选九秒九五，不是因为九秒九五更接近海因斯真正跑了多快，那个真正的数字没有人知道，连千分之一秒的机器测到的也只是它自己那套系统里的一个读数。它选九秒九五，是因为从某个时刻起，它决定以机器那块布为准。
patches.after_zh: 不能把这个选择说成已经取得了毫无误差的真实用时；机器给出的也是一套测量系统里的读数。但这并不否认全自动计时能够提高准确性。这里还有一个制度上的决定：从某个时刻起，哪一套测量结果被统一采用，作为正式比较的标准。
patches.before_en: It chose 9.95 not because that number was closer to how fast Hines truly ran. No one knows that true number; even a machine measuring thousandths produces only a reading within its own system. It chose 9.95 because, at a certain point, it decided that the machine's cloth would be authoritative.
patches.after_en: That choice did not deliver a perfectly error-free elapsed time; a machine, too, supplies a reading within a measurement system. This does not deny that fully automatic timing can improve accuracy. There is also an institutional decision: from a particular point onward, which system's readings will be used consistently as the official basis of comparison?

patches.before_zh: 这不是发现了真相，是选定了一个标准。
patches.after_zh: 这不只是把一个数测得更准，也是选定共同采用的标准。
patches.before_en: This was not the discovery of truth. It was the selection of a standard.
patches.after_en: This was not only a matter of measuring more accurately. It was also the selection of a shared standard.

patches.before_zh: 九秒九五不是海因斯真正跑了多快
patches.after_zh: 九秒九五是对海因斯那次用时的记录，不是那次奔跑的全部
patches.before_en: 9.95 is not how fast Hines truly ran.
patches.after_en: 9.95 records the duration of Hines's run; it does not contain the whole event.

findings.before_zh: 在十项全能里，这是一个能把奥运冠军和一个入不了决赛的选手分开的差距。
findings.after_zh: 值得先注意这五个总分之间的数字差距：八千四百一十二和六千二百六十七，相差两千一百多分。它们不是两名运动员在同一张表下的分差，不能直接套成冠军与另一名选手之间的竞技差距；十项全能也不是先取得决赛资格再争冠军的赛制。这里显出的，是同一个人的同一场比赛，换了计分尺度就会换一个总数。成绩没有重做，账面上的大小却明显变了。
findings.before_en: In the decathlon, that is enough to separate an Olympic champion from a competitor unable to reach a final.
findings.after_en: First notice the numerical distance between the five totals: more than 2,100 points separate 8,412 from 6,267. This is not a gap between two athletes scored on the same table, so it cannot simply be translated into a difference in competitive ability. Nor does a decathlon ordinarily progress through qualification into a final. The point is that the same athlete's same performances acquire a different total when the scale changes. Nothing has been performed again, yet the number in the ledger has shifted dramatically.
findings.reason: Remove invented final and avoid treating units under different scales as directly commensurable ability gaps. This preserves the example and central scoring-convention point.

findings.location: EP07 section 1 paragraph 12; section 8 paragraphs 4 and 17
findings.reason: The five totals illustrate five selected tables, not five revisions of one initial table. Section 2 itself discusses an additional 1962 revision. Do not assert there were no five major revisions in history; simply avoid deriving an exhaustive count from the chosen samples.

patches.after_zh: 而这张表，曾多次修订。上面选了五个版本来比较，并不是列出了全部修订。
patches.before_en: And that table has been changed five times.
patches.after_en: And that table has been revised repeatedly. The five versions selected above illustrate those changes; they are not an exhaustive history.

patches.before_zh: 因为它可以被重新发明，所以它被重新发明了五次。
patches.after_zh: 它也确实被反复改写；前面选取的五个版本，让这种变化显了出来。
patches.before_en: Because it can be reinvented, it has been reinvented five times.
patches.after_en: It has indeed been rewritten repeatedly, as the five selected versions show.

patches.before_zh: 变过五次，今天还挂着两个。
patches.after_zh: 在这里选取的五张表下有五种结果，今天的历史介绍里也可能同时列出原分与现行表重算分。
patches.before_en: has changed five times and still appears in two versions today
patches.after_en: has five different values under the five selected tables, while historical accounts may display both an original and a current-table total

findings.reason: The same 1.87m is not similarly near the Olympic record in two eras. A lower score for one unchanged old performance establishes different conversion, not by itself that the entire event was devalued against all others or that every athlete with strengths there must lose total points.

patches.before_zh: 是因为现行表把跳高这个项目在整个十项里的估价压低了，同样接近纪录的成绩，换到的分数少了。成绩没动，它在总盘子里的分量被调小了。
patches.after_zh: 是因为计分基准和换算方式已经改变。同样是一米八七，在1912年接近当时奥运纪录，并不意味着今天也同样接近纪录。这里能直接看见的是：成绩没动，换到的分数少了；只凭这一点，还不能断定跳高在所有水平上相对其他项目都被调低了。
patches.before_en: because the current table has reduced the valuation of the high jump within the decathlon. A similarly near-record performance buys fewer points. The performance has not moved; its share of the total has been reduced.
patches.after_en: because the benchmarks and conversion have changed. A height close to the Olympic record in 1912 is not thereby equally close to the record today. What this comparison directly shows is that an unchanged height earns fewer points. On its own, it does not establish that high jumping has been devalued against every other event at every performance level.

patches.before_zh: 索普强在跳高和栏，而现行表恰恰调低了跳高和栏的估价，所以他的总分整体是跌的。一个在铅球和铁饼上强的运动员，换到现行表下可能是涨的。表的每一次重写，都在悄悄地改变历史上哪些十项全能选手更值钱。
patches.after_zh: 在索普这组成绩里，跳高和栏换到现行表后都少了分，总分也下降了。另一种成绩组合的变化未必相同；它要看十项各自的实际成绩和新旧曲线，不能只凭擅长哪一项就下结论。表的重写因此可能改变跨时代比较里不同类型选手的相对位置。
patches.before_en: Thorpe excelled in the high jump and hurdles, precisely the events the current table has devalued, so his total declines overall.
patches.after_en: In Thorpe's set of performances, the high jump and hurdles earn fewer points under the current table, and his total falls. A different combination of performances need not change in the same way: the result depends on the actual marks and both scoring curves, not simply on which event is an athlete's strength. Revising the table can therefore change the relative positions of different kinds of athletes in cross-era comparisons.

findings.type: source recalculated comparison versus legal result
findings.location: EP07 section 3 paragraph 13; section 4 paragraph 12; section 7 paragraphs 10–12
findings.reason: Section 8 correctly distinguishes parallel historical presentation from legal replacement. Earlier categorical statements must match that limit, instead of relying on the ending to undo an impression that medals and all official historical results automatically change. A physical finish can also have later adjudication; avoid claiming an unchangeable legal verdict.

patches.before_zh: 若干年后表一改，他的总分和所有人的总分一起被重算，他在历史序列里的排名可能上升，也可能下降
patches.after_zh: 若干年后，若用新表对旧成绩作跨代重算，他和其他人的比较分都会变化，在这个重算序列里的位置可能上升，也可能下降；这不等于原赛事的奖牌和正式结果自动改判
patches.before_en: Years later, a change in the table recalculates his score along with everyone else's. His historical ranking may rise or fall
patches.after_en: Years later, if past marks are recalculated for cross-era comparison under a new table, his comparative score and those of other athletes may change. His position in that recalculated sequence can rise or fall; the medals and official results of the original event do not thereby change automatically

patches.before_zh: 而每一次换立场，所有历史成绩的总分排序都跟着变一次。
patches.after_zh: 而每一次换立场，若据此重算旧成绩，跨代比较中的总分和排序就可能变化；这和改判原比赛是两件事。
patches.before_en: Each change altered the ordering of historical totals.
patches.after_en: If past marks are recalculated under each policy, their totals and comparative order can change. That is distinct from revising the original competition results.

patches.before_zh: 把胜负系于一个物理事实，胜负就被锁死在了那一刻;把胜负系于一个计算，胜负就永远暴露在重新计算的可能之下。十项全能选择了后者，于是它的每一个历史结论都是可修改的。
patches.after_zh: 把最后的比较落在终点线上，后来换算表的改变不会改变当时谁先冲线；当然，正式结果仍可能涉及犯规等裁决。十项全能则还多一层：即使十个原始成绩不动，换一张表也能算出不同的比较总分。可重算的是这种比较，不是说每一届正式胜负都随新表自动重写。
patches.before_en: Tie victory to a physical fact and it is locked into that moment. Tie it to a calculation and it remains forever exposed to recalculation. The decathlon chose the latter, making every historical conclusion revisable.
patches.after_en: A later conversion table does not change who crossed the line first, although official results can still involve rulings on infringements. The decathlon adds another layer: even with ten unchanged marks, a different table can produce a different comparative total. That comparison can be recalculated; it does not follow that every original official result is automatically rewritten.

patches.before_zh: 表一变，所有历史总分跟着变。索普那五个总分就是这么来的。
patches.after_zh: 表一变，若把历史成绩放进新表，比较总分就会变化。索普那五个数是同一组成绩在不同表下的结果，不是五次依次取代原裁决的正式成绩。
patches.before_en: Change the table and every historical total changes. This is how Thorpe acquired five totals.
patches.after_en: If past performances are fed into a new table, their comparative totals change. Thorpe's five totals are the outputs of different tables, not five successive official verdicts replacing the original one.
patches.additional_edit: Paragraph opening must likewise be conditional: 在十项全能里，修订后的表可以被拿来重算历史比赛的成绩 / In the decathlon, a revised table can be applied to the performances of past competitions.

patches.before_zh: 一改写，整本账里所有的旧条目都被重新算过一遍。

patches.before_en: When they are, all its old entries are recalculated.
patches.after_en: Rewriting them makes a parallel historical comparison possible; it does not automatically replace the official results established under the rules of each original event.

findings.reason: The paragraph goes beyond the essay's own bounded statement of unsuccessful reconstruction to assert that no derivation was ever written down and no one can explain it. findings.before_zh: 而这些数字是根据什么定出来的，不公开，或者说，从来没有被完整地写下来过。所以这个构处在一个位置上:它执行着一套精确的规则，而这套规则的来源它自己也讲不清楚。
findings.after_zh: 而这些数字怎样一步步定出来，在这里查到的公开材料中，还不能完整复建。不能因此断定当时从未写过，或者机构内部也无人知道；这里留下的问题是，公众可以精确执行这套规则，却未必能从现有公开资料完整重走它的制定过程。
findings.before_en: Yet the basis on which those numbers were chosen is not public, or rather was never fully written down. The construct executes an exact rule whose origin it cannot itself fully explain.
findings.after_en: The public material located here does not allow the choice of those numbers to be reconstructed step by step. That does not establish that no complete account was ever written or that no one within the institution knew it. The remaining gap is between being able to execute a precise public rule and being able to retrace its development from the available public record.

findings.before_zh: 北欧两项也是这样。它把跳台滑雪的分数，通过贡德森方法换算成越野滑雪的出发延迟。个人的五到十五公里比赛，官方的换算是每一分对应四秒。
findings.after_zh: 北欧两项的个人贡德森赛制也有类似办法：把跳台滑雪的分差，按每分四秒换成越野滑雪的出发延迟。这里说的是这种赛制，不是北欧两项的全部比赛；紧凑赛等赛制另有安排。
findings.before_en: Nordic combined does the same. Through the Gundersen method, ski-jumping points become delayed starts in cross-country skiing. In individual races of five to fifteen kilometres, the official conversion is four seconds per point.
findings.after_en: Individual Gundersen events in Nordic combined use a similar approach: each point of the ski-jumping deficit becomes four seconds of delayed cross-country start time. This describes that format, not all Nordic combined competitions; formats such as the Compact use different arrangements.
findings.reason: FIS explicitly distinguishes Gundersen, Compact and Mass Start. Keep the paragraph's finishing-order explanation qualified to the selected format. No need to rewrite the whole comparison as a survey of Nordic skiing.
